description: This file defines interfaces and data classes related to streaming grains in Orleans, including producers, consumers, and their states, as well as observer interfaces for test logic.

classes.name: Streaming_ProducerGrain_State
classes.description: Serializable class representing the state of a producer grain, containing a list of producers.

classes.name: Streaming_ConsumerGrain_State
classes.description: Serializable class representing the state of a consumer grain, containing a list of consumers.

classes.name: Streaming_ProducerConsumerGrain_State
classes.description: Serializable class representing combined state for producer-consumer grains, with lists of producers and consumers.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Sets this grain as a consumer for a specific stream.

methods.name: StopBeingConsumer
methods.description: Stops this grain from being a consumer.

methods.name: GetItemsConsumed
methods.description: Returns the number of items this consumer has consumed.

methods.name: GetConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns the count of consumers.

methods.name: DeactivateConsumerOnIdle
methods.description: Deactivates the consumer when idle.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Configures the observer as a producer for a stream.

methods.name: RenewProducer
methods.description: Renews the producer with provided logger and stream provider.

methods.name: StopBeingProducer
methods.description: Stops the producer's operation.

methods.name: ProduceSequentialSeries
methods.description: Produces items sequentially.

methods.name: ProduceParallelSeries
methods.description: Produces items in parallel.

methods.name: ProducePeriodicSeries
methods.description: Produces items periodically using a timer create function.

methods.name: ExpectedItemsProduced
methods.description: Gets the total expected items to be produced.

methods.name: ItemsProduced
methods.description: Gets the number of items produced so far.

methods.name: AddNewConsumerGrain
methods.description: Adds a new consumer grain to the producer observer.

methods.name: VerifyFinished
methods.description: Verifies if the production is finished.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Configures the observer as a consumer for a stream.

methods.name: RenewConsumer
methods.description: Renews the consumer with provided logger and stream provider.

methods.name: StopBeingConsumer
methods.description: Stops the consumer's operation.

methods.name: ItemsConsumed
methods.description: Gets the number of items this consumer has consumed.

methods.name: ConsumerCount
methods.description: Gets the count of consumers.

methods.name: ProviderName
methods.description: Gets the name of the stream provider.
